title: Brand Look: Avatar Icons

freshness.note: options reused from wellnest-brand-look-2 (split, not new)

brands: Avatar options 1-5 in depth: tiles, rings, sizes, place icons
Locked WellNest brand: original nest logo, Cormorant + DM Sans, gold leads, peach accent, sand lines; white deck background; drawn SVGs, sample content only
Avatar: keep original nest logo (Max note on look-1 #13 Use own logo); look-2 still has avatar detail pairs — do not treat as switching away from nest.
Card 1: peach+white vs gold+black main button retest from look-1 #15/#19 split; trailing pair dropped to keep 20.
